name: guard_auth_events_update
body: BEGIN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Authentication audit entries cannot be modified'; END

name: guard_auth_events_retention
body: BEGIN IF OLD.created_at >= DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Authentication audit entries must be retained for at least 12 months'; END IF; END

name: guard_policy_evidence_update
body: BEGIN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Security policy evidence cannot be modified; append a correction'; END

name: guard_policy_evidence_delete
body: BEGIN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Security policy evidence cannot be deleted'; END
